capabilities: Convert selected text to title, upper, lower, or swap case
Convert selected text to camel, Pascal, snake, or kebab case
Apply conversions to multiple selections at once
Assign keyboard shortcuts to the conversion commands
extras: The README includes developer release instructions (release bump helper, git workflow) that are not relevant to users.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for converting the case of selected text to programming or writing case styles.
summary: Case converter that changes selected text to common case styles (title, camel, snake, kebab, and others) via commands.
